text.en:
The name of the Tagkawayan School of Fisheries established in the Municipality of
Tagkawayan, Province of Quezon, is hereby changed to Judge Guillermo Eleazar School of fisheries.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of December in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
